name: Strix
description: Run bounded, authorized-use-only Strix security analysis against an existing local repository directory.
whenToUse: Use only for authorized security testing of a local repository or application directory that the operator owns or has explicit permission to assess.
Run when a bounded automated security scan is appropriate and the user has explicitly provided --authorized.
Use for local source-code or app-directory security analysis, not for probing third-party URLs, domains, IP addresses, or systems.
failureModes: The local strix command is not installed, is not release 1.0.4, or its locked Python runtime dependencies have drifted from openai-agents 0.14.6, openai 2.44.0, and litellm 1.90.1.
Docker is not installed, the Docker daemon is unreachable, or Strix cannot start its local execution environment.
The target is missing, not a directory, or is a URL, domain, IP address, or inline input, all of which are rejected by this bounded capability.
The scan may require LLM/API credentials; capability-control must never print or persist API keys in output, evidence, or ledger records.
Strix may return exit code 2 when findings are discovered; this is treated as a completed run, not a command failure.
